_doc: Declarative routine spec, read by the swarm-setup skill. Model is an alias so it works in any account's catalog. Cron uses CRON_TZ so DST is handled by the scheduler.
prompt: Run the macro-release skill in this repository. Follow CLAUDE.md. If nothing is pending, answer in one line and stop.
why_this_schedule: 11:07 ET catches the 08:30/10:00 prints after the 10:45 ET collector run; 17:07 ET catches the afternoon (FOMC 14:00, collector 16:15 ET). Quiet runs exit after one command.
